note: Both sets contain essentially the same claims, including the same chart point readings from Figure 7-2 and the same textual claims (47,402.91 N•m saturation, 15,000 N•m/s rate limit, 1° blade-pitch trigger, gain-scheduled PI, 1173.7 rpm rated speed, high drivetrain damping, no torsional damping loop). The only differences are cosmetic: B adds a 'Region 3' condition to the rated-speed claim and keeps 'baseline' as a condition rather than in the entity name, while A writes the rate limit without a thousands separator. Both sets share the same duplicated claims (the 0 N•m variable-speed claim twice, and the same Optimal-curve points stated under both 'Optimal' and 'Optimal Controller') and the same weak legend-label quotes for the chart readings.
remarks: Both sets duplicate the Variable-Speed 0 N•m claim and state identical Optimal-curve points under two entity names ('Optimal' and 'Optimal Controller'). Chart-derived claims use legend labels ('Optimal', 'Variable-Speed Controller') as quotes, which do not support the numeric values; the values themselves are plausible readings of Figure 7-2 but only approximate. Both sets omit several page facts: the single-DOF drivetrain model and equation of motion (Eq. 7-5), the Region 3 conditional's purpose (improved output power quality with fewer dips below rated at the cost of short-term generator/gearbox overloading), and 'In Region 3, the blade-pitch control system takes over.'
